name: dsh-desktop-theme-guard
description: DSH client+host patch: makes the desktop app's Appearance=System option follow the real OS theme. DeepSeek Harness Desktop pins the native window appearance from ui-theme.preference in settings.yaml, which overrides prefers-color-scheme inside the embedded WKWebView; this plugin feeds the theme service the OS appearance probed out of band and keeps the preference explicitly written so the shell stops pinning.
